# DeSerres

> DeSerres is Canada's premier destination for fine art supplies, creative hobbies, and professional framing services since 1908.

DeSerres offers a comprehensive range of art materials including paints, canvases, drawing supplies, and creative hobby products for both professional artists and hobbyists. The site features curated collections, seasonal projects, gift options, and an in-house product line alongside premium brands like Faber-Castell, Winsor & Newton, and Liquitex.

## Key Topics

- Art Supplies
- Acrylic Paint
- Oil Paint
- Watercolor & Gouache
- Canvases & Surfaces
- Colored Pencils
- Markers & Fineliners
- Painting Materials
- Creative Hobbies
- Artist Tools
- Craft Materials
- Home Studio
- Painting Techniques
- Aerosol Paint
- Gift Cards

## Core Collections

- [Art Supplies, Creative Hobbies & Framing | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca): DeSerres homepage: fine arts destination since 1908 with art supplies
- [Fine Art and Graphic Design Supplies | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca/collections/art-graphic): Main art and graphic design supplies collection for professionals and kids
- [Best Sellers | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca/collections/best-sellers): Best-selling art supplies, paints, puzzles, and creative hobby products
- [New Arrivals | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca/collections/new-arrivals): New arrival products in arts, crafts, and creative hobbies

## Painting Supplies & Materials

- [Artist Paint | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca/collections/art-graphic-paint): Painting supplies: acrylic, watercolour, oil, and aerosol paints
- [Acrylic Paint for Beginners and Professional Artists | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca/collections/art-graphic-paint-acrylic-paint): Acrylic paints from Liquitex, Golden, Pébéo, Winsor & Newton
- [Watercolor & Gouache Paint for Artists | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca/collections/art-graphic-paint-watercolour-gouache): Watercolour and gouache paints from Daniel Smith, Winsor & Newton
- [Oil Paint - Wide Selection for Artists and Beginners | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca/collections/art-graphic-paint-oil-paint): Oil paints from Winsor & Newton, Liquitex with mediums and techniques
- [Aerosol Paint | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca/collections/art-graphic-paint-aerosol-paint): Spray paint from Krylon, Molotow, Sabotaz for artists and amateurs
- [Painting Sets for Christmas | DeSerres](https://www.deserres.ca/collections/painting-sets): Painting sets with acrylics, watercolours, oils for gift-giving
